title: Hypergroup Correspondence for Discrete Conformal Subnets
exact_target: Match discrete conformal subnets with compact hypergroups of quantum operations, including a meaningful infinite-index theory.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30004282 (OWR-17292-006). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Subfactors and Applications (2019), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2019/49, pp. 3053--3140. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 29, 30, 35, 36.
Bischoff--Del Vecchio--Giorgetti, quantum operations on conformal nets (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).
Bischoff--Del Vecchio--Giorgetti, compact hypergroups from discrete subfactors (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The compactness, discreteness and action definitions are themselves part of the target. A finite-index correspondence alone does not establish the requested bijection and intrinsic infinite-index framework.
